goal: Finalize and verify Streamlit auth error UX against real staging responses, using the updated 401/403 friendly warning flow as baseline.

inputs.description: Streamlit runtime routing and auth error rendering.
Frontend report with 401/403 UX hardening already applied.

constraints.notes: Do not change API/security contracts. Scope is UI/auth-state verification and minimal bug-fix only.

acceptance: 401 and 403 cases show friendly UI messaging in staging flow, with reproducible steps and evidence.
Raw JSON error blobs are not exposed as the primary UX surface.
Frontend regression checks pass after any final UX patch.

risk.note: Frontend UX pass is not valid unless tied to real gateway/auth responses.

next_actions: Submit result.json with changed files and staging verification evidence.
If backend dependency blocks verification, mark status partial with exact blocker.
Hand off verified UX evidence to CT for final decision.
